title: Obstruct multidirectional actuators within a common curl eigenspace
statement: Let all actuators lie in the same positive curl eigenspace E_lambda. For every v there, (v.nabla)v=gradient(|v|^2/2)-v cross curl(v) has zero Leray projection and Delta v=-lambda^2v. Thus the FULL nonlinear smooth dynamics inside E_lambda is U(t)=exp(-nu lambda^2t)U0+integral exp[-nu lambda^2(t-s)]f(s)ds. For U0=+/-v,||v||H1=M, at least one endpoint has L2 norm>=M exp(-nu lambda^2tau)/sqrt(1+lambda^2), defeating arbitrary epsilon for every force from that family. Explicit noncollinear rational fields (0,sin(kappa x1),cos(kappa x1)),(cos(kappa x2),0,sin(kappa x2)),(sin(kappa x3),cos(kappa x3),0) all have curl=kappa times themselves. This includes actual smooth realizations and hence defeats an all-Leray-Hopf guarantee for these families; mixed helicities/frequency shells may destroy invariance, so no full-family impossibility is claimed.
